prompt: I ___ (study) for my driving test since breakfast, and I still have two chapters left.
explanation: La actividad empezó en el pasado, continúa ahora y aún no está terminada.

prompt: Marta's hands are covered in blue paint because she ___ (paint) the bedroom all morning.
explanation: Las manos manchadas son el resultado visible de una actividad reciente.

prompt: I have not been ___ (sleep) well lately, so I am finding it hard to concentrate.
explanation: have not been fija la forma negativa; después de been se usa el verbo en -ing.

prompt: How long ___ (you / wait) outside in the rain?
explanation: How long pregunta por la duración de una actividad que llega hasta ahora.

prompt: The children are muddy because they ___ (play) football in the garden.
explanation: El barro es una consecuencia presente de la actividad reciente.

prompt: Why ___ (the baby / cry) for the last twenty minutes?
explanation: for the last twenty minutes marca una actividad en curso y su duración.

prompt: The builders have not been ___ (work) on the roof all week because the wind has been too strong.
explanation: have not been fija la forma negativa; work añade -ing para expresar la actividad.

prompt: Nora has been using the meeting room all morning.
solution: Nora hasn't been using the meeting room all morning.
explanation: not se coloca después de has; been y el verbo en -ing no cambian.

prompt: They have been testing the new app since Tuesday.
solution: Have they been testing the new app since Tuesday?
explanation: La interrogativa coloca have delante del sujeto.

prompt: The kitchen smells wonderful because Leo has been baking since early this morning.
explanation: since marca el inicio y el olor actual es el resultado de la actividad reciente.

prompt: I have been reading the novel for two hours, and I am only halfway through.
explanation: La actividad dura hasta ahora y sigue sin terminar; importa el proceso, no un resultado completo.

prompt: How long have you been preparing for the interview?
explanation: How long pregunta por la duración desde el pasado hasta el presente de una actividad dinámica.
